propositions: The Pass-1 model_ladder uses bare Anthropic model names, so its entry rung copied into cfg.model resolves to direct Anthropic even when the run is configured for another provider.
The ladder should be expressed as capability-class names (trivial, standard, frontier) resolved at runtime through the class config, making it provider-portable.
Class names are reserved values in the existing model-string space with no new class: key and no schema change, resolved at the single config.resolve_model funnel.
sizing.MODEL_LADDER and models_at_or_above() hardcode bare Anthropic ids and return them for runtime escalation, so a Bedrock run silently escalates to direct Anthropic.
Escalation ladder rungs must also become class names resolved through the same funnel so escalation stays within the configured provider.
Literal model ids must keep resolving unchanged so existing workflows are unaffected and migration is opt-in.
